title: Sanctuary for a mind under assault
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 205
summary: The shabad opens with a direct cry to the Father God for rescue. It carries the listener through the five thieves attacking the being, the sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, and ends when divine light dawns in the mind.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who is already afraid and no longer able to pretend control. Kept sincere, it gives fear a cleaner movement than panic: cry out, take shelter, and wait for light.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: call for shelter before fear becomes your only voice.

lines.translation: Save me, O My Father God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਸਭ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh niragun sabh gun tere ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am worthless and without virtue; all virtues are Yours. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਗਰੀਬਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch bikhaadhee ek gareebaa raakhahu raakhanahaare ||
lines.translation: The five vicious thieves are assaulting my poor being; save me, O Savior Lord!

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khedh kareh ar bahut sa(n)taaveh aaio saran tuhaare ||1||
lines.translation: They are tormenting and torturing me. I have come, seeking Your Sanctuary. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar haario anik bahu bhaatee chhoddeh katahoo(n) naahee ||
lines.translation: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਤਾਕੀ ਓਟਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek baat sun taakee oTaa saadhasa(n)g miT jaahee ||2||
lines.translation: But I have heard that they can be rooted out, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; and so I seek their Shelter. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa sa(n)t mile moh tin te dheeraj paiaa ||
lines.translation: In their Mercy, the Saints have met me, and from them, I have obtained satisfaction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tee ma(n)t dheeo moh nirabhau gur kaa sabadh kamaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Saints have given me the Mantra of the Fearless Lord, and now I practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeet le oi mahaa bikhaadhee sahaj suhelee baanee ||
lines.translation: I have now conquered those terrible evil-doers, and my speech is now sweet and sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak man bhiaa paragaasaa paiaa padh nirabaanee ||4||4||125||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the state of Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125||

structure: The shabad opens without bravado, asking the Father directly for rescue.
From there it names the assault honestly and turns toward sanctuary rather than self-sufficiency.
The closing movement rests with the mind lit from within after company, grace, and shelter have done their work.
